source.derives_from: Microsoft Qlib/RD-Agent is the lineage named by alpha-forge; this read follows that declared repository-level lineage

scope.question: Does the nearest Qlib/RD-Agent lineage preserve proposed and failed experiments before evaluation and across crashes?

evidence: RDLoop logs the generated hypothesis and experiment before coding or running
LoopBase snapshots the whole loop after each successfully completed step
FactorRDLoop routes declared FactorEmptyError/CoderError failures to feedback; the record step then appends the failed experiment and feedback to Trace.hist
findings.implication: Independent convergence on the good half of s41-s43: identity must exist before expensive evaluation, and typed expected failures must end in a durable terminal record.
findings.limitation: The guarantee covers successful steps and explicitly declared skip-loop exception classes, not every failure. An undeclared exception is re-raised before terminal feedback/record.

evidence: LoopBase.dump opens the final checkpoint path directly with wb and pickle.dump; there is no temporary file, fsync or atomic replace
LoopBase.load chooses the latest numeric session file and calls pickle.load without checksum, schema or fallback-to-previous validation
findings.implication: A crash during checkpoint write can destroy the newest recovery point. Step-frequency checkpointing is not durability unless checkpoint commit is atomic and verified.
findings.repair_test: Kill during serialization; reject the incomplete generation and resume from the last checksum-valid atomically renamed checkpoint without losing the prewritten trial row.

evidence: those methods delete session checkpoints and object logs after the selected point
findings.implication: The source offers rollback, not an append-only evidence ledger. Restored control state and immutable trial history require different artifacts and truncation semantics.

evidence: session snapshots, hypothesis objects and experiment logs are persisted as Python pickle by default
restart and log iteration deserialize those pickles directly
findings.implication: Mine the framework as text only. Transfer typed append-before-evaluate state into a data-only format with explicit schema and hashes; do not ingest or execute its artifacts.
